response:
Reflection on prior evidence: the two evaluated signals share the "profitability net of a financing claim" family, and the cleaner, level-based one (Profit Net of Debt Service Burden: fmb 2.38, FF5 alpha 2.8%, t 2.86) beat the volatility-interacted one (fmb 1.74, t 1.49). That suggests (a) balance-sheet claim adjustments to profitability carry real content, (b) five-year volatility interactions cost coverage and add noise, and (c) coverage of ~0.13 is suspiciously low, likely driven by `oibdp`/`oiadp` availability, so I test a broader income construction (`revt − cogs − xsga`) as a coverage/measurement repair. I also add three genuinely different quality channels: liquidity-based repayment capacity, retained-earnings corroboration, and working-capital-financed profitability, plus one design-isolating industry-adjusted variant of the archive winner.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Operating Income Net Of Debt Service
EXPRESSION: WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), at), RATIO(ADD(xint, dlc), at)), 1)
HYPOTHESIS: Operating income built from revenue less cost of goods and overhead, net of interest paid and debt maturing within a year, measures the profit genuinely available to shareholders after financing claims; this uncommitted profit yield predicts returns better than gross profitability.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This isolates two design choices relative to the archive winner: replacing `oibdp` with the `revt − cogs − xsga` construction (far more broadly reported, which should lift coverage from 0.13 toward mainstream levels) and winsorizing to stop small-asset outliers from driving the FMB slope. If both fmb_tstat and ls_talpha improve, the prior result was measurement-constrained rather than mechanism-constrained.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Debt Repayment Capacity Profit
EXPRESSION: WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(SUB(act, lct), oiadp), lt), 1)
HYPOTHESIS: Profitability is durable when the firm could retire its obligations from the combination of existing liquid slack and one year of operating profit; the same profit level is worth less when total liabilities dwarf that capacity.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This changes the quality channel from debt-service flow (interest and maturities) to stock-level solvency measured against liquid working capital, so the numerator interacts profit flow with balance-sheet slack while the denominator scales by the full claim. It is a distinct economic statement from the archive winner — repayment capacity rather than annual coverage — and will show whether the previous alpha came from liquidity risk or from committed-cash-flow drag.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Retained Earnings Corroborated Profit
EXPRESSION: MIN(RANK(RATIO(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), at)), RANK(RATIO(re, at)))
HYPOTHESIS: Current operating profitability is credible only when the firm has actually accumulated earnings over its life; high current margins with little retained earnings signal a transient or first-cycle profit, while deep retained earnings without current profitability signal decay.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The MIN of two ranks is a strict conjunction, not an additive composite: a firm scores high only if it clears both the current-profit and the cumulative-profit-history bar, so the long leg is exactly "durable operating strength" and neither single-theme sort reproduces it. Retained earnings to assets is a long-horizon persistence proxy that requires no rolling window, so unlike five-year volatility measures it costs no coverage.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Self Funded Profit Improvement
EXPRESSION: SUB(TREND(RATIO(oiadp, at), 5), TREND(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), at), 5))
HYPOTHESIS: Improving profitability is high quality when it is achieved while leverage is falling, and low quality when the margin trend is accompanied by rising debt-financed asset growth; the difference in trends isolates organically funded operating improvement.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This moves the interaction from levels to dynamics — the joint direction of profitability and financing — which no level-based profitability or leverage sort captures. It tests whether the archive's level-based financing adjustment can be strengthened by a flow-of-funds interpretation, at the cost of a five-year window whose coverage impact we can read directly against Signal 1.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Working Capital Clean Profitability
EXPRESSION: WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(oiadp, at), RATIO(DELTA(SUB(act, lct), 1), at)), 1)
HYPOTHESIS: Operating profit that is simultaneously absorbed by expanding receivables and inventories is not distributable; subtracting the year's investment in net working capital converts reported profitability into self-financing profitability.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The quality channel here is balance-sheet accrual absorption measured with `act` and `lct` rather than any financing item, so it is economically distinct from debt-service and solvency variants and from the signed accruals anomaly (it penalizes working-capital build-up only net of the profit level, in matched asset-scaled units). Both terms are same-unit flows, avoiding the rank-scale mismatch that sank the earlier count-weighted proposal.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Industry Relative Uncommitted Profit
EXPRESSION: IND_ADJ(SUB(RATIO(oibdp, at), RATIO(ADD(xint, dlc), at)))
HYPOTHESIS: Because both EBITDA margins and debt-maturity structure are largely set by industry technology, only the within-industry component of uncommitted profitability reflects firm-specific durable operating strength.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This holds the archive winner's mechanism fixed and varies one design choice — industry demeaning — to test whether its alpha was partly a static sector bet (capital-intensive, high-debt industries versus asset-light ones), which would show up as a weaker FF5 loading and a cleaner long-short spread. If ls_talpha and ls_sharpe rise while alpha holds, subsequent generations should apply industry adjustment throughout.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---CRITIQUE Operating Income Net Of Debt Service---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: In Compustat `oibdp` is definitionally `revt − cogs − xsga`, so this is the archive winner "Profit Net of Debt Service Burden" re-expressed with a winsorizer — a cosmetic variant whose only genuine content is a data-availability/outlier robustness check, not a new mechanism.

---CRITIQUE Debt Repayment Capacity Profit---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The stock-solvency framing (working-capital slack plus one year of profit against total liabilities) is a defensible economic alternative to the flow-coverage archive signal, though it is close in spirit to the classic Altman Z-score components and the unwinsorized `lt` denominator will blow up for low-liability firms, so the outlier control should be inside the ratio rather than absent.

---CRITIQUE Retained Earnings Corroborated Profit---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The MIN-of-ranks conjunction is a genuinely non-additive combination that neither parent sort reproduces and the expected sign matches the construction, but both legs are individually published anomalies (gross/operating profitability and retained-earnings-to-assets à la Ball–Gerakos–Linnainmaa–Nikolaev), so the incremental content rests entirely on the nonlinearity and should be benchmarked against a simple average of the same two ranks.

---CRITIQUE Self Funded Profit Improvement---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The trend-difference moves the interaction from levels to dynamics and is internally consistent in sign and units, but the leverage-trend leg is a slow-moving proxy for the well-documented net debt issuance/financing anomaly, and the unstandardized subtraction implicitly assumes the two trends have comparable cross-sectional dispersion — worth testing, but the decomposition into each leg should be reported to show the interaction adds anything.

---CRITIQUE Working Capital Clean Profitability---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Operating profit minus the change in net working capital, both scaled by assets, is essentially the Sloan (1996) accrual adjustment and reproduces cash-based operating profitability (Ball et al. 2016); the reasoning's claim that it is "distinct from the signed accruals anomaly" is not supported by the expression, which is exactly earnings-less-working-capital-accruals.

---CRITIQUE Industry Relative Uncommitted Profit---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This applies a single mechanical demeaning transform to an already-evaluated archive signal without changing the mechanism, which is precisely the kind of cosmetic variant the objective warns against; industry adjustment is better folded in as a standard preprocessing choice tested alongside a substantively new construct than proposed as a standalone signal.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Return Spread Over Borrowing Cost
EXPRESSION: WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(oiadp, ADD(ceq, lt)), RATIO(xint, lt)), 1)
HYPOTHESIS: Profitability is only durable operating strength when the return earned on total capital employed exceeds the interest rate the firm actually pays creditors; a levered firm earning less on assets than it pays on liabilities is transferring value to debtholders regardless of its headline margin.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
REASONING: This is not the archive winner re-scaled: it compares two rates rather than subtracting a cash claim from a profit level, so the quality channel is the realized cost of debt (xint/lt) and the interaction is the sign and size of the economic spread that determines whether leverage adds or destroys shareholder value. Scaling interest by total liabilities rather than by interest-bearing debt keeps the denominator strictly positive for essentially all non-financials, so coverage should be as good as a plain ROA sort.
---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Internally Financed Capital Base Profit
EXPRESSION: WINSOR(MUL(RATIO(oibdp, at), RATIO(ADD(re, TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5)), lt)), 1)
HYPOTHESIS: Current operating profitability is more persistent when the productive capital behind it was financed by accumulated earnings and sustained R&D spending rather than by creditors, because internally funded assets carry no fixed claim and reflect a proven history of profitable reinvestment.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
REASONING: The multiplicative form makes profitability count in proportion to how much of the firm's capital base is self-generated (retained earnings plus five-year cumulative R&D) relative to creditor claims, which is a funding-origin mechanism rather than an accrual or debt-service adjustment. COALESCE treats unreported R&D as genuinely zero spending, so non-innovators are still ranked by retained earnings and no part of the cross-section is mechanically excluded.
---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Trough Profit Versus Fixed Claims
EXPRESSION: WINSOR(SUB(TS_MIN(RATIO(oibdp, at), 5), RATIO(ADD(xint, dlc), at)), 1)
HYPOTHESIS: The relevant test of durable operating strength is whether the firm's worst recent year of profitability would still have covered its committed interest and maturing debt; firms passing this stress test have profits that cannot be extinguished by a normal downturn.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
REASONING: Replacing the current profit level with its five-year minimum turns the financing adjustment into an explicit downside stress test, so the signal separates firms whose current coverage rests on a cyclical peak from those whose floor clears their claims — a state-dependent mechanism no accruals or cash-profitability measure captures. Both terms remain asset-scaled and unit-consistent, and the trough operator is the sharpest available expression of "persistent" in the economic story.
